book.name: 1Tesalonika
book.title: 1Tesalonika Tesalonika Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa Ibiꞌa

content: Nego nabudi, Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa bare ariteꞌe madaḡaꞌe zae veize mene mirihiꞌuma.
Mazaḡa za edeḡa hune, Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa bare ariteꞌe madaḡaꞌe ḡonoreꞌa ohere areꞌeteꞌe teigiꞌuma.

Vazeꞌa raenaꞌa, “Emeꞌe uniho manoḡano sauꞌa ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa radiuꞌohe,” rae raꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano aduga boroꞌa feuradu ze tabara ruiziꞌuma. Aꞌe roḡae ahiꞌetaniꞌa ene furenoga radu gigiꞌaniꞌa feurohuꞌeteꞌe teigiꞌuma. Ebu zeꞌe aduga boro eꞌe mode feranoga mene idaraꞌuma.
Rehano nego nabudi, zaꞌe mene uzabo zamaḡano radiuꞌe ꞌahine, Iesuꞌa bare ariteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ḡonore teige aradu za mene zaguzaguziꞌuma.
Zae niduꞌa madai zu agaḡa zamaḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa. Emeꞌe ohere zu uzabo zamaḡano mene radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo emeꞌe bazeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mene teigiꞌuma, rehano evateꞌenaꞌa, tohutohe radiꞌuma.
Mazaḡa bazeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ohereo bazeꞌohe ebu gagone fuꞌa azaḡaꞌe ohereo gage futauꞌohe.

Rehano emeꞌe madai zamaḡano radiuꞌe ꞌahine, tohutohe radiꞌuma. Ebu fieꞌenaꞌa zamarotitiꞌuma, aꞌe utio ꞌuꞌuni biriḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe heuḡa. Ebu ḡabone hidiꞌuma rae mae ḡihineꞌenaꞌa guhiniꞌuma, aꞌe uti karaḡauḡa haḡadu vadini bireꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.
Badiꞌaꞌe zamaḡa ḡugiꞌa hina aduga rififine emeḡe mene ohotiro, rehano emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Keriso uꞌano ḡabone hidifine ohotiro.
Kerisoꞌa emeḡe veize rudaro. Aꞌe emeꞌa ḡabode radiuꞌeteꞌe ga rudaroteꞌe zamaḡano ani teite radoga veize raꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌe inaratitoꞌi ebu danatitoꞌi. Izidi hube hune zaeꞌa ꞌouge haḡaeꞌeteꞌe teige, ꞌouge haḡaeꞌenoꞌi.
Ihore Ḡoeꞌa Ḡonaga
Nego nabudi, eme umizeꞌohe. Zae boꞌaḡano gau boro haḡaeꞌenaꞌa, Zuhiꞌa Boro ḡoere idunaḡano zae ibitoziꞌeteꞌe zu ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa gubazoꞌi.
Zeḡeꞌa zae veize gaueꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, ze zamare borofeꞌenaꞌa zamaze niduꞌa hina gubazoꞌi. Zaezae niduꞌa uniho manoḡa zamaḡano radoꞌi.
Nego nabudi, eme umizeꞌohe. Tubuḡa azaḡaꞌe riḡa iraduguzoꞌi, rihauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe inarazoꞌi, zoreḡa azaḡaꞌe danazoꞌi, ebu vaze niduꞌa mazao zamaze obone giganoꞌi.
Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ꞌahoga mazao sauꞌa haḡaoꞌidene, sauꞌa hina ago naenaenoꞌi, rehano zae boꞌaḡano zu vaze niduꞌa mazao iḡaiḡa manoḡa haḡaoꞌi.
Mada niduꞌa matuꞌe radoꞌi.
Iḡaiḡa kuranoꞌi.
Naginiꞌa fureranoꞌidene zuni, Badiꞌa mazao manoḡa tauḡi roꞌi. Eꞌeguḡa niduꞌaꞌe zaeꞌa Keriso Iesu teite tiburanadu radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa zae mazaonoꞌo urateꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa.
Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa zae mazao gaueꞌeteꞌe ago ꞌuoꞌi.
Badiꞌaꞌa ihozadu rae fureneꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa ago reꞌoreꞌone modoꞌi.
Ḡau niduꞌa tuhune ḡianoꞌi. Manoḡa ḡauḡa obone giganoꞌi.
Sauꞌa nunuonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi.

Emeꞌe zama roḡeḡa rifiꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa aneꞌa ḡau niduꞌa moneo zae mae zaḡozaḡozifine kurauꞌohe. Ebu Badiꞌaꞌa danazadu emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Kerisoꞌa bare ariteꞌe madaḡano vineze zu ahirizeꞌe veꞌoḡa oꞌoꞌa radifine kurauꞌohe.
Zae huziroteꞌe Badiꞌaḡaꞌe zamaḡa niduꞌa hina haḡaeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, aniꞌa hube hune ꞌouge haḡaiꞌuma.
Nego nabudi, emeḡe veize kuranoꞌi.
Nego nabudi niduꞌa kavarotiteꞌenaꞌa, unihotitoꞌi.
Zuhiꞌa Boro niḡano ḡoere riḡa ziꞌohe. Soꞌa ꞌahiꞌe nego nabudi niduꞌa veize meꞌodoꞌi.
Emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Kerisoꞌa zae mazao manoḡa fureneꞌenoꞌi.
